Ralph Waldo Emerson once said, “an institution is the lengthened shadow of one man.” In NVIDIA’s case, the shadow of its CEO and co-founder, Jensen Huang, is a haunting one. Many within Silicon Valley see Huang as a visionary genius , whose vision as the “ Godfather of AI ” has improved billions of lives around the world and contributed greatly to American prosperity and innovation.
